transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal launch-governance meeting, I need each functional counsel to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet before I give final authorization for the October 1 external availability of our clinical documentation platform. To recap where we stand: the platform completed its internal engineering pilot with no unresolved performance blockers, and the current launch packet uses our standard software, privacy, product-description, and enterprise-contract templates. Please go through your areas one by one and flag anything that must be added or changed.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we proceed. My completed license review of the production build confirmed that module M-17 incorporates an AGPL-licensed library. Under our company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access. I have not yet added this result to the launch packet, and this condition must be addressed and documented before final authorization for the October 1 launch.

transcript.text: I need to flag a privacy issue. In the signed design-partner agreement, I confirmed that customer content may not be used to train or improve our models and must be deleted within exactly 30 days after account termination. The standard privacy template currently in the launch packet does not include these commitments, and the privacy language must be revised before final authorization for the October 1 launch.
